targets.expected_type:
∀ {Source : Type} {World : Type}
  (M : Nightfall.SemanticFencing.System Source World)
  (obs : Source → World → Bool)
  (readPrice checkPrice : Source → ℕ)
  (L : Set World → ℕ),
  Nightfall.SemanticFencing.BellmanLowerCertificate
    M obs readPrice checkPrice L →
  ∀ (B : Set World) (p : Nightfall.SemanticFencing.EvidencePlan Source),
    Nightfall.SemanticFencing.PlanValid M obs B p →
    L B ≤ Nightfall.SemanticFencing.worstCost readPrice checkPrice p

∀ {Source : Type} {World : Type}
  (M : Nightfall.SemanticFencing.System Source World)
  (obs : Source → World → Bool)
  (readPrice checkPrice : Source → ℕ)
  (L : Set World → ℕ),
  Nightfall.SemanticFencing.BellmanLowerCertificate
    M obs readPrice checkPrice L →
  ∀ (B : Set World) (p : Nightfall.SemanticFencing.EvidencePlan Source),
    Nightfall.SemanticFencing.PlanValid M obs B p →
    Nightfall.SemanticFencing.worstCost readPrice checkPrice p = L B →
    ∀ q : Nightfall.SemanticFencing.EvidencePlan Source,
      Nightfall.SemanticFencing.PlanValid M obs B q →
      Nightfall.SemanticFencing.worstCost readPrice checkPrice p ≤
        Nightfall.SemanticFencing.worstCost readPrice checkPrice q
